raw_segments.text: Two sheets cream vellum paper, one reserved two envelopes when I was in Wisdom Healy's
Wise Bloom and Dolly's Henry Flower bot.
Are you not happy in your home?
Flower to console me and a pin cuts low.
Wise Bloom eyed on the door a poster, a swaying mermaid smoking mid-nice waves.
Smoke mermaids, coolest whiff of all.
He eyed and saw afar on Essex Bridge a gay hat riding on a jaunting car.
It is, again, third time, coincidence.
